title: Fast second search ends with an older answer
description: Searching for oak, then immediately searching for pine, briefly shows pine but eventually shows oak. Both requests appear successful; the reporter suspects a server error.
expected: Once both searches finish, the field and result both correspond to pine.
actual: Oak desk replaces Pine desk despite pine remaining in the field.
steps: Immediately submit pine before the earlier request finishes.
Wait for both requests to finish and inspect the result.
